what_happened: Upstream Verification-repo ruling (template.typ's obligation-list/data-table/data-list convention comment) was already complete and unambiguous, so the research dispatch transcribed it directly into both target context files and committed the edits itself (via git-commit-scoped.sh) rather than deferring to a separate plan/implement cycle, since per git-staging-scope.md research-phase postflight never auto-commits non-task-directory source files.

The research dispatch (seq 2) did not merely research: it performed all three of the task's implementation edits and committed them as 7af9640c9 before any plan existed. The plan phase therefore found the work already landed and was reduced to verification plus one mechanical gap (stale index-entries.json line_count values) the research dispatch left behind.
